ENGLISH 210: THE VICTORIAN NOVEL
Fall 2026 — Prof. M. Okonjo — Tuesdays 3:00–5:30 PM, Goldwin Smith 156

A note on how this course works. We meet once a week for two and a half hours,
and the seminar depends entirely on your having done the reading. I do not give
quizzes; instead, your preparation shows in discussion.

You will write three papers. The first, a close reading of a single passage of
roughly four pages, is due on the ninth of September. I will return these with
comments within two weeks. The second paper, eight to ten pages, asks you to put
two novels in conversation, and I need it by five o'clock on the twenty-first of
October. The third is the seminar paper, fifteen to twenty pages, due at the end
of term on December the eighth.

In addition, each of you will lead one seminar discussion. The sign-up sheet goes
around in our second meeting and I will confirm assignments by September 15.

There is a take-home midterm covering the first half of the syllabus. I will
distribute it on October 6 and it is due back one week later.

Reading for the first four weeks: Oliver Twist (Aug 25), Jane Eyre (Sep 1),
Wuthering Heights (Sep 8), and Bleak House, which we will spend two weeks on
beginning September 15.
